title: Persist bounded server-owned OAuth Recovery evidence while external source authority remains fail-closed

phases.objective: Persist the five server-owned OAuth Recovery observations in the existing execution_log with exact operation, correlation and deployment binding, without claiming external callback or registration authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging Tenant GPT OAuth authorization server and Activation protected-resource gateway
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Five bounded server-owned Recovery observations can be read back for one exact OAuth operation/correlation/deployment while callback_received remains absent and external Recovery source authority remains unavailable.
steps: Record authorize_received after the server creates and signs oauth_authorize correlation.
Record login_consent_completed only after identity resolution advances the same correlation to identity_verify.
Record authorization_code_issued from the same oauth_code_issue correlation after durable code-row binding is established.
Record token_exchange_completed from the governed token route after exact code consumption and oauth_token_exchange advancement.
Record resource_request_verified only after bearer verification advances the verified correlation to gateway_verify.
Persist only bounded no-secret evidence to execution_log.runtime_evidence_json.
Reject callback_received at the server-owned sink and keep Registration source attestation outside this scope.
Do not sign an acquisition receipt, run the Recovery canary, apply a migration, create activation_run, mutate a provider, or mutate Production.
assertions: The sink allows exactly five server-owned Recovery event names and rejects callback_received.
The sink writes only execution_log and creates no table or parallel OAuth correlation ledger.
Raw OAuth code, access token, refresh token, credentials, cookies and secrets are not accepted as evidence fields.
Canonical hash tampering, stale evidence, deployment drift and cross-operation or cross-correlation reads fail closed.
Production runtime performs no Recovery evidence database mutation.
Live OAuth handlers contain no callback_received event writer.
Registration parity does not become provider-backed source authority in this PR.
Recovery OAuth source verification and acquisition receipt signing remain blocked until genuine external callback authority is implemented.
